verdict.rationale: Datadog ships its own agents (Bits AI), so it is fair to ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. The evidence pack only documents an official Datadog MCP server, which exposes Datadog to other agents. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. No evidence shows Datadog connecting to or using tools from external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
